svg.title: Person hover card — F68 mockup, six panels
svg.desc: Top row: the card opened from each v1 surface, one per skin — a film page “Billed on the release” dashed chip in Cinémathèque, a /search page person row in Broadcast, a “More with” shelf title in Brutalist. Each card: 48px 1:1 headshot at left; name in the display font with a nationality flag; a muted meta line “41 · 27 titles · 3 films”; an italic “also credited as” alias line; a rule; a link row Profile · Titles · Films · TMDB provider badge; and, for the owner only, a second row Enrich · Edit. Bottom row, all Cinémathèque: the loading state (name line only, no spinner), a sparse visitor state (no age, no films → those segments and the Films link are simply absent; the headshot is the backend’s themed placeholder), and the corner case where the chip sits at the bottom-right of the viewport so the card opens above it, end-aligned.
svg.text: Person hover card (F68) — one card, three skins, three surfaces; loading, sparse and corner states
BILLED ON THE RELEASE — IN NO SCENE YOU OWN
opens at 250 ms with the name it already has;
fills in when GET /people/{id}/card lands — no spinner
Loading — name line only, no spinner
visitor · no birthdate → no age · 0 films → no
Films link · headshot = backend themed placeholder
Sparse / visitor — segments dropped, not dashed
